video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] I counted people in all 36 cells from 0.000 to 8.750 s. Every cell has exactly one person, a woman with long black hair on the stairs on the left, carrying a lamp. The courtyard on the right and the second-floor walkway stay empty. Nobody appears, leaves or doubles, and the count at 0 s (1) matches the count at 8.75 s (1).

video.no_text.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] Ignoring the yellow timecode the review tool adds in each top-left corner, I found no subtitles, watermarks, logos or UI in any of the 36 cells from 0 to 8.75 s. The walls, doors and sky show no readable text either.

video.object_continuity.evidence: 2026-11-14 按现行规则重审（作者，_review/climb_1fps.jpg、lamp.jpg 全分辨率）：油灯 0–8.75 秒一直在她右手掌上点着、只有灯嘴一朵火苗，左手立在火苗外侧挡风（0.5/2/4.5/5.5/7.5 秒放大）；0–3 秒一级级往上走，约 4.5–5.5 秒回头朝画面右下方看一眼（侧脸被灯照亮），6–8.75 秒继续上楼走出画面上缘，没有停成摆件；看点「护着火苗一级级爬上石楼梯」落地。偏差：比现行分镜少了拐进二楼走廊、灯光远去的尾拍（条长 9 秒、分镜 12 秒），记录。旧 fail 来自缩略图上拿不准即判 fail 的旧规则。
